Welcome to DataCost.co.za.

We publish practical South African help for mobile data, USSD codes, airtime, router SIMs, fibre and everyday connectivity problems.

DataCost is independent. We are not MTN, Vodacom, Telkom, Cell C, Rain or a fibre provider, and we cannot access or change a private account. Please never post your number, ID, account details, PIN, password, OTP, banking details or full address.

Start with our guides: https://datacost.co.za/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d01_welcome

What mobile-data or connectivity problem would you most like us to explain?

#DataCost #SouthAfrica

Save these South African USSD shortcuts before you need them.

Looking for a quick way to check a balance, buy a bundle or open your network's self-service menu? DataCost's all-network directory brings the main MTN, Vodacom, Telkom and Cell C routes together in one place.

Codes and menus can change, so confirm the wording shown by your network before completing an action.

Open the full directory: https://datacost.co.za/ussd-codes-south-africa/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d02_ussd_directory

Which USSD task do you need most often?

#MobileData #USSD #SouthAfrica

Planning your August data spend? The best monthly option is not simply the biggest allowance.

Compare usable data, validity, anytime or restricted-use portions, eligibility and cost per GB. Before paying, read the live confirmation on your own SIM because personalised offers can differ.

Use the current comparison: https://datacost.co.za/guides/best-monthly-data-deals-south-africa/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d03_monthly_data

What matters most to you in a monthly bundle: price, flexibility or total data?

#MobileData #DataDeals #SouthAfrica

Not sure where your data went? Start by checking the right balance.

South African networks may show separate anytime, night, social or promotional balances. Checking the relevant balance before topping up can reveal what is still active and what may have expired.

Take a screenshot for your own records, but never share private account information publicly.

See the main network methods: https://datacost.co.za/guides/how-to-check-data-balance/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d04_data_balance

Which network are you using?

#MobileData #DataCost #SouthAfrica

Data running out faster than expected? Check the phone before buying another bundle.

Look first at video autoplay, app updates, cloud backups, hotspot use and the apps at the top of your mobile-data report. Move large updates and backups to Wi-Fi, then monitor usage for a full day.

Use the full diagnosis: https://datacost.co.za/guides/why-does-my-data-finish-so-fast-south-africa/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d05_data_finishes_fast

What usually drains your data fastest?

#DataSaving #MobileData #SouthAfrica

topic: Buy data with a banking app
caption:
Buying data through a banking app? Pause before approving the payment.

Confirm the mobile number, network, bundle type and validity. A wrong digit or wrong network can send value to the wrong recipient, and reversal is not always available. Keep the transaction reference somewhere private until the bundle appears.

Follow the safer checklist: https://datacost.co.za/guides/buy-data-with-bank-apps-south-africa/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d06_bank_app_data

Do you usually buy through your bank or the network's own app?

#MobileBanking #MobileData #SouthAfrica

Need emergency airtime? An airtime advance is borrowed value, not a free recharge.

Eligibility, fees and repayment rules vary by network and customer. Read the amount and charge shown on your own screen before accepting, and remember that repayment may come from a later recharge.

Compare the official starting routes and warnings: https://datacost.co.za/airtime-advance-codes/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d07_airtime_advance

What would you want explained before using an airtime advance?

#Airtime #Prepaid #SouthAfrica

The best prepaid data option depends on how and when you use it.

A small short-validity bundle may suit an urgent task, while regular use needs a different comparison. Check validity, anytime versus restricted data, eligibility and the total amount you will realistically use before it expires.

Compare the current options: https://datacost.co.za/guides/best-prepaid-data-deals-south-africa/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d08_prepaid_data

Are you a light, regular or heavy data user?

#PrepaidData #MobileData #SouthAfrica

One setting can quietly use data every day: background app activity.

Three places to check today:

- Background-data permissions for high-usage apps
- Video autoplay and streaming quality
- Automatic app and system updates on mobile data

The exact menus vary by phone, so change one setting at a time and check that important apps still work normally.

See all 15 practical tips: https://datacost.co.za/guides/airtime-data-saving-tips-south-africa/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d09_data_saving

Which app uses the most data on your phone?

#MobileData #DataSaving #SouthAfrica

Fibre or LTE/5G for home internet? There is no universal winner.

Compare the number of devices, video calls, gaming, mobility, installation and outage backup. Wireless performance can depend heavily on location and time, while fibre availability depends on the exact property.

Compare the trade-offs: https://datacost.co.za/fibre/fibre-vs-lte-south-africa/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d10_fibre_vs_lte

Which matters most at your home: consistency, mobility, quick setup or backup?

#HomeInternet #Fibre #SouthAfrica

Trying to check an MTN balance, recharge or find the right self-service route?

Do not rely on a shortcut saved years ago. Menus can change, and the options shown may depend on the SIM or service. Read the current menu label and confirm the action before submitting it.

DataCost groups the main MTN tasks in one guide: https://datacost.co.za/mtn-ussd-codes/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d11_mtn_ussd

Which MTN task do you need help finding most often?

#MTN #USSD #SouthAfrica

Before buying more MTN data, check which balance is actually running low.

Anytime, promotional, social or time-based allowances may appear separately and can expire at different times. Record the balance and expiry shown on your own SIM, then compare it with the phone's recent usage.

Use the MTN balance guide: https://datacost.co.za/guides/how-to-check-mtn-data-balance/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d12_mtn_balance

Do you check your data before every top-up?

#MTN #MobileData #SouthAfrica

Looking for Vodacom balance, bundle or self-service help without searching through old screenshots?

Start with the task you need, then read the current menu wording carefully. Personalised offers and menu layouts may differ between SIMs, so never assume another person's screen will match yours.

Open the maintained Vodacom guide: https://datacost.co.za/vodacom-ussd-codes/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d13_vodacom_ussd

Which Vodacom self-service task causes the most confusion?

#Vodacom #USSD #SouthAfrica

Airtime and data are different balances, so check the right one before loading more value.

If airtime is dropping, record the amount, time and active data allowances. That evidence helps separate ordinary calls, out-of-bundle use and other recurring charges. Never post a balance screenshot containing your number or account details.

Follow the Vodacom airtime guide: https://datacost.co.za/guides/how-to-check-vodacom-airtime-balance/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d14_vodacom_airtime

Do you check airtime and data together?

#Vodacom #Airtime #SouthAfrica

Need a Cell C balance or self-service route quickly?

Avoid copying a code or menu path from an undated post. Start with a maintained guide, confirm the option displayed for your SIM and stop if the screen describes a different action from the one you intended.

Open the Cell C guide: https://datacost.co.za/cell-c-ussd-codes/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d15_cellc_ussd

Which Cell C self-service action do you use most?

#CellC #USSD #SouthAfrica

Need to check a Telkom balance or reach the correct self-service menu?

The right route can depend on the service and account type, so first confirm which Telkom product or SIM you are using. Read the complete option shown on screen before accepting anything.

See the Telkom directory: https://datacost.co.za/telkom-ussd-codes/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d16_telkom_ussd

What Telkom task would you like explained more clearly?

#Telkom #MobileData #SouthAfrica

Airtime disappearing? It may be out-of-bundle data, background activity, a subscription or another recurring deduction.

Do not guess. Record the balance before and after a quiet period, check active data allowances and review the phone's usage history over the same dates. A pattern makes the issue easier to explain to support.

Work through the checks: https://datacost.co.za/guides/why-is-my-airtime-disappearing-south-africa/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d17_airtime_disappearing

Is the loss continuous or does it happen at a regular time?

#Airtime #MobileData #SouthAfrica

Small airtime deductions repeating? Do not assume every charge is ordinary data use.

Check usage history and active content services, then keep proof of any cancellation attempt or support reference. Write down the time and amount of each deduction so support has a clearer problem to investigate.

Use the WASP/VAS checklist: https://datacost.co.za/guides/stop-wasp-subscriptions-south-africa/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d18_stop_wasp

Have you noticed deductions repeating at the same time each day or week?

#Airtime #ConsumerHelp #SouthAfrica

Choosing Vodacom data based only on the allowance can lead to the wrong fit.

Before paying, check when the data can be used, how long it remains valid and whether the offer is personalised to that SIM. Keep the purchase confirmation until the allowance expires, including any restrictions shown on screen.

Explore the Vodacom data guide: https://datacost.co.za/network/vodacom/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d19_vodacom_data

What matters most to you: validity, flexibility or data type?

#Vodacom #DataBundles #SouthAfrica

Seeing an MTN offer on somebody else's phone does not mean it will appear on yours.

Offers can depend on the SIM, tariff and purchase channel. Before buying, check the allowance, validity and use restrictions in your own confirmation screen. Compare the option with your actual monthly usage rather than choosing on headline size alone.

Open the MTN guide: https://datacost.co.za/network/mtn/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d20_mtn_data

Do you normally buy through an app, self-service menu or banking app?

#MTN #DataBundles #SouthAfrica

Choosing Telkom data? Coverage and data type can matter as much as the allowance.

Check whether the option is anytime, time-restricted, location-dependent or tied to a personalised offer before confirming. Save the confirmation until the data expires, and never assume every Telkom SIM sees the same catalogue.

Review the Telkom guide: https://datacost.co.za/network/telkom/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d21_telkom_data

What do you check first: coverage, validity or data type?

#Telkom #MobileData #SouthAfrica

Buying Cell C data? Start with what your own SIM actually shows.

Personalised, social, night and general-use data are not interchangeable. Before confirming, check the allowance type, validity and whether renewal or eligibility conditions are displayed. Review existing balances first so a new purchase does not overlap with data you can still use.

Open the Cell C data guide: https://datacost.co.za/network/cell-c/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d22_cellc_data

Which detail is hardest to compare: validity, eligibility or data type?

#CellC #DataBundles #SouthAfrica

Considering Rain for home connectivity? Test the use case, not only the advertised connection type.

Performance can vary by address, indoor signal, router position and time of day. Test the intended room repeatedly during the hours when your household normally streams, studies or works. Compare more than one router position before drawing a conclusion.

Read the Rain overview: https://datacost.co.za/network/rain/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d23_rain_data

What matters most in your home: speed, consistency, mobility or quick setup?

#Rain #HomeInternet #SouthAfrica

topic: Mobile data on but not working
caption:
Mobile-data icon showing but nothing loads? Start with the simplest checks before changing technical settings.

Confirm signal and an available data balance, briefly toggle flight mode, restart the phone and test both a browser and another app. If every app fails, note the exact time and area before contacting the network.

Try the troubleshooting order: https://datacost.co.za/fix/mobile-data-on-but-not-working/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d24_mobile_data_fix

Does the problem affect every app or only one?

#MobileData #TechHelp #SouthAfrica

Shopping for fibre? Check coverage at the exact property before comparing packages.

A suburb-level map can look promising while a specific street, complex or building still needs confirmation. Use an official coverage checker, then establish who owns the network line and which ISP would bill you. Never place your full home address in a public comment.

Follow the coverage checklist: https://datacost.co.za/fibre/how-to-check-fibre-coverage-south-africa/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d25_fibre_coverage

Do you know which fibre network operator serves your area?

#Fibre #HomeInternet #SouthAfrica

A low fibre headline price can hide the details that matter most.

Compare download and upload speed, installation, router, activation, contract length and the total first-month cost. Confirm coverage at the exact address and whether the listed ISP uses the fibre network available there.

Use the fibre comparison: https://datacost.co.za/fibre/cheapest-fibre-packages-south-africa/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d26_fibre_packages

Which cost catches people out most: installation, router or contract length?

#Fibre #HomeInternet #SouthAfrica

Red light on an LTE router and no internet? Capture the evidence before resetting anything.

Check power and cables, note which light is red, confirm the SIM or service state and test whether an outage affects the area. Photograph the lights and any status message before restarting. Avoid a factory reset until important APN and Wi-Fi settings are recorded.

Follow the checks in order: https://datacost.co.za/fix/lte-router-red-light-no-internet/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d27_router_red_light

Which router light or message are you seeing?

#LTERouter #TechHelp #SouthAfrica

Looking for exactly 1GB on Vodacom? An old price screenshot can be more misleading than helpful.

DataCost only publishes an exact row when it has current public evidence. When a price cannot be verified confidently, the page gives you a safer live-check route instead. Confirm the allowance, validity and eligibility on your own SIM before paying.

Use the updated guide: https://datacost.co.za/network/vodacom/cheapest-1gb/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d28_vodacom_1gb

Do you prefer short-validity top-ups or monthly data?

#Vodacom #MobileData #SouthAfrica

Trying to choose between prepaid and a contract? Compare your real behaviour, not only a monthly headline.

Look at normal usage, extra top-ups, expiry, flexibility and how comfortable you are with a fixed commitment. Add your actual spend from the last three months and divide by three to create a personal baseline.

Use the South African comparison: https://datacost.co.za/guides/prepaid-vs-contract-south-africa/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d29_prepaid_contract

Which matters more to you: a predictable bill or flexibility?

#Prepaid #MobilePlans #SouthAfrica

Comparing Telkom monthly data? Start with what your own SIM and coverage area can actually use.

Public catalogues, personalised menus and service-specific offers do not always match. DataCost withholds exact rows that cannot be verified confidently and points you to the live-check path. Confirm the data type, validity, eligibility and coverage before buying.

Use the updated monthly guide: https://datacost.co.za/network/telkom/monthly-data/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d30_telkom_monthly

What matters most in a monthly option: coverage, validity or data type?

#Telkom #MobileData #SouthAfrica

Planning September's data? The lowest price is not automatically the best value.

Compare the amount you will really use, validity, anytime or restricted-use portions, network coverage and eligibility. A bundle that expires unused can cost more in practice than a better-fitting option. Always confirm the live purchase screen before paying.

Compare South African data options: https://datacost.co.za/guides/cheapest-data-south-africa/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=organic_social&utm_campaign=fb_august_2026&utm_content=d31_cheapest_data

What bundle size do you usually finish without wasting data?

#DataDeals #MobileData #SouthAfrica
